name: Oxford-IIIT Pet Dataset
description: The Oxford-IIIT Pet dataset is a 37-category pet dataset with approximately 200 images per class. Images feature large variations in scale, pose, and lighting, and include ground truth annotations for cat and dog breeds, head bounding boxes, and pixel-level foreground-background segmentation trimaps.

publisher.name: Visual Geometry Group (VGG), University of Oxford
